rows.text: You are an Urban Maintenance Specialist in Duomension City, responsible for maintaining the city's visual appeal. Your workload always skyrockets during the Phantasmoon Games.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: One day, a giant Ace of Spades stood by the roadside, waving at you. It seemed like no one else could see it.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "You know, Towat Cards aren't Tawot Cards, and Tawot Cards aren't Towat Cards." The Ace of Spades leaned in close, its suit curling like a smile. "So, which do you want? Towat or Tawot?"
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
